summary: Make an analysis rerunnable from a named dataset version with clear permissions and manageable compute requirements.
outcomes: Record dataset identity, version, license, exclusions and environment.
Reproduce a small result without silently changing data or analysis choices.
sequence: Find a question and a suitable open dataset
Read consent, access and license conditions
Inspect DANDI or equivalent metadata before downloading
Select a bounded subset and preserve identifiers
Build a rerun and sensitivity report

visual.question: Can another learner trace this figure back to raw observations?
visual.interaction: Select an output to reveal dataset version, transforms, parameters and environment.

practice.task: Reproduce one small figure from an open deidentified dataset.
practice.success: Provides dataset citation, reproducible commands, checksums or version IDs and stated departures from the source analysis.
